name: mcp-zap-connect
description: Guided Docker Compose setup for local MCP ZAP Server in Codex, Cursor or Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Set up or reconnect MCP ZAP Server and ZAP on your machine using the project's Docker Compose setup in local Codex. Requires local command execution, Git, a POSIX shell, and Docker with Docker Compose already installed and running. Java and ZAP run inside the containers. Ask the setup skill to obtain the project, start its versioned release containers, and configure a separate authenticated MCP connection after startup succeeds. Existing settings and reports are preserved. Installing this skills-only plugin does not install Docker, start the scanner, or expose MCP tools. Setup verifies the connection with a status call; it does not run a scan. Codex may need reconnection or a restart to load a changed MCP connection. Scanning requires a separate request identifying your authorized target and intended workflow. Web-only chats cannot reach your machine's loopback server. Settings, keys and reports stay in your installation; prompts and MCP results are handled by your AI provider. This independent project is not affiliated with or endorsed by ZAP or OpenAI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up the local scanner in Codex. Verify with a status call only; do not run a scan.

publication.release_notes: Add Claude Code plugin packaging and private HTTP connection instructions to the shared Docker Compose setup skill. Reuse the existing scanner, preserve other clients' settings, and verify with a status call only. The plugin does not bundle an MCP server or run scans on installation.
